reason: I already pay a setter who works my inbox, and if my calls are slow I figure it's my offer or my content, not the DMs. Nothing here shows me it beats the person I already have.
objection: No customer results published and only 7 seats taken. I'd be handing over a card and doing the review work myself on a tool nobody has proven books calls, and I'd still pay my setter.
would_change_my_mind: Real booked-call numbers from coaches like me, ideally a case where it replaced a setter's cost, plus a way to try it without a card.
